A Partner Powered 2026: Celebrating a Strong Year and Looking Ahead to the Next


omcgee


Mon, 11/16/2026 - 16:32


As the year wraps up, we want to pause and say thank you. Join us for a special Partner Amplify session celebrating everything we accomplished together in 2026. We’ll cheer on standout partner wins, share our excitement about being named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, and highlight the awards Five9 received from our partners this year. We’ll also share what we heard from you through the Partner Advisory Board (PAB) and how your voice is shaping what comes next. Then we’ll look ahead to 2027 with an overview of Five9’s signature events and their expected dates, a preview of upcoming partner program updates, and a glimpse of where we’re headed together. Bring your questions and your holiday spirit, and let’s close out the year, and start the next one, together.
